definitions: Take on or assume (an attitude, custom, or way of life).
Legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.
Choose to take up, follow, or use (a new method, law, etc.).
Take (a child) into one's family by legal means and raise it as one's own.
Formally vote to accept or be in favour of (a proposal, motion, or amendment).
examples: The couple decided to adopt a child.
She adopted a more positive outlook.
Many countries have adopted this policy.
